root_cause: Existing Powerhouse/Brain runtime readback updates shared domainState but does not invalidate already mounted native detail page, and identity boundary did not clear mounted private panel.
fix: Bind existing provider-readback runtime events, dedupe by canonical runtime data, preserve dirty forms, wipe DOM at original tenant boundary.
prevention_rules: Re-render a native page only on changed authenticated canonical runtime evidence, never merely on polling.
Clear all mounted native customer content at account transition, even in hidden panels.
Missing provider writeback or outcome proof cannot be rendered as verified business improvement.
